question: What definition of 1C is used, and what share of theoretical capacity is reached on the first discharge at 0.1C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%0.1C%' OR text ILIKE '%theoretical%' OR text ILIKE '%C-rate%' OR text ILIKE '%C rate%' ORDER BY page, id

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (3,5) AND (text ILIKE '%C =%' OR text ILIKE '%mA/g%' OR text ILIKE '%1675%' OR text ILIKE '%first%discharge%' OR text ILIKE '%first cycle%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page=5 AND line_no BETWEEN 58 AND 66 ORDER BY line_no
